title: Observe real EUR action-panel reveal geometry
platforms: Desktop core interpreter on Linux; GUI and native Windows untested
changes: Record a bounded action-menu close and reopen, observed changing backing and owner bounds, and diagnostic 100/150 percent packed layers.
validation: Two corrected 72-frame interpreter captures produced identical frame metadata; selected packed layers were inspected. Existing EUR ROM and snapshot hashes remained unchanged.
limitations: Initial zero-extension setup disabled capture and is invalid; corrected run used 22-pixel side extension. Diagnostic layers do not prove a visible GUI defect, mouse alignment, stable owner, native execution, USA, Android or native Windows behavior.
